# Asia Chip Supply Tightens, Prices Keep Rising  
**Bottom line:** Supply risk stays elevated (71.6) and price pressure intensifies (85.3), so lock in volume now.

## What changed
- Market supply risk unchanged at 71.6 (neutral shift) and price‑trend unchanged at 85.3, both labeled “Elevated” and “Rising fast” respectively[1].  
- Producer price index (+9.1% annualized) and global chip sales (+148.3% YoY) continue to push both supply tightness and price increases[1][2].  
- TSMC’s 3‑month revenue up 50.9% YoY signals higher foundry loading, reinforcing the supply squeeze[3].  
- Fab utilization at 76.5% remains below the 10‑yr average, offering a modest loosening offset[4].  
- Component book‑to‑bill at 1.05 shows orders outpacing shipments, adding to the tighter outlook[5].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time 14 weeks, stock 27,081 units, no on‑order quantity or arrival data.  
- Price $5.56 / 1 pc; $2.51 / 1 k pcs.  
- Origin Austria, tariff 0 % (no surcharge).  
- Supply risk 54.3 (Neutral) and price trend 69.4 (moderate rise).  
- Buy‑timing call: **Hold course** – 58 % chance prices rise, but no strong timing signal[6].

*(none)*  

## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – Supply 71.0 (Elevated, ↔), Price 82.1 (Rising), High confidence.

- Analog & power management – Supply 68.4 (Rising, ↔), Price 77.2 (Rising), High confidence.

- Power discretes (MOSFET / IGBT / SiC / GaN) – Supply 66.7 (Rising, ↔), Price 82.7 (Rising), High confidence.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **W25Q128JVSIQ** – Lead time 52 weeks vs ~12‑week norm (factory bottleneck).  
- **IRF540NPBF** – Lead time 38 weeks vs ~12‑week norm (factory bottleneck).  
- **SN65HVD230DR** – Lead time 26 weeks vs ~12‑week norm (factory bottleneck).  
- **LM358DR** – Lead time 26 weeks vs ~12‑week norm (factory bottleneck).  
- **TPS62130RGTR** – Lead time 26 weeks vs ~12‑week norm (factory bottleneck).

## Outlook
- Chip prices next 3 months: 66 % probability of rise, expected +2.17 % (range ‑9.57 % to +13.91 %), model‑tested edge.  
- Chip prices next 6 months: 52 % probability of rise, expected +4.34 % (range ‑8.79 % to +17.46 %), trend‑following baseline.  
- Fab utilization next 3 months: 63 % probability of tighter supply, expected +1.82 pts (range ‑1.71 pts to +5.36 pts), baseline.  
- Fab utilization next 6 months: 60 % probability of tighter supply, expected +3.64 pts (range ‑2.16 pts to +9.45 pts), baseline.  

## Negotiation angle
- Push for **volume‑based price locks** on high‑risk memory and power MOSFETs (lead times > 26 weeks) to hedge the 58‑%+ price‑rise probability.  
- Request **priority allocation** or early‑ship clauses for parts flagged “Buy ahead / lock pricing” (e.g., IRF540NPBF, W25Q128JVSIQ).  
- Use the neutral supply rating of the featured MOSFET (IPB017N10N5ATMA1) as a benchmark to argue for **stable pricing** on comparable devices while monitoring the 58 % price‑rise signal.
